# Invitation: Data for Small Business Seminar

Dear Members,

On behalf of the Riverside Chamber of Commerce, I am pleased to invite you to our Data for Small Business Seminar. The afternoon brings together owners who have put their own records to work, and we hope you will join us.

## Event details

Date: Friday, November 20, 2026, 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM (registration opens at 1:30 PM)

Venue: Harbor Point Conference Center, Hall A, 7th floor

Capacity: 120 seats, first come, first served

Organizer: Riverside Chamber of Commerce, Business Support Office

## Program

| Time | Session |
| --- | --- |
| 13:30 | Registration opens |
| 14:00–14:10 | Welcome |
| 14:10–15:00 | Keynote: Data for the Small Company |
| 15:00–15:15 | Break |
| 15:15–16:15 | Case study: Cutting Stock with Order Records |
| 16:15–16:55 | Panel discussion |
| 16:55–17:00 | Closing remarks |

## Fees (per person)

| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Seminar fee | $45 |
| Workbook | $20 |
| Networking reception (optional) | $35 |
| Total | $100 |

The networking reception follows the seminar at 5:15 PM in the lounge on the 2nd floor of Harbor Point Conference Center.

## How to register

Please register by Friday, November 13, 2026, by returning the enclosed form or by phone. As of November 6, 95 members have registered.

Registration and questions: Business Support Office, Tel: (617) 555-0142

On the day, please show your confirmation slip at the main reception desk of Harbor Point Conference Center.

We look forward to seeing you there.

Sincerely,
